excerpt: A Postgres developer at Microsoft noticed his SSH logins burned ~500ms of CPU they shouldn't, and that Valgrind was throwing weird errors in liblzma. He profiled it, because Andres Freund is the kind of person who profiles half a second. What he found was a backdoor in xz/liblzma wired into sshd, already shipped to Debian sid, Fedora 40/41 beta and openSUSE Tumbleweed, and weeks from riding stable releases everywhere. The payload is world-class tradecraft. And it's still the boring half of the story.
title: The maintainer was the exploit
